h:
另一个 ST 工作流程，但希望不像我见过的其他工作流程那么大。在我的 3060 上，图像需要 15 秒才能完成，所有 28 个图像大约需要 7 分钟。更新主要是为了修复节点问题。如果你的有效，则无需更新。最适合黑色背景的图像。

工作流程中有更多说明，但要记住的最重要的事情是将批量大小设置为 28 以获取所有表情。

使用 NodeAligner 对齐的节点：
https://github.com/Tenney95/ComfyUI-NodeAligner

这是用 Comfy 版本和旧版本 Python（从 2025 年 6 月 27 日开始）制作的。较新的版本有一些关于 WAS Suite 的废话，以及任何阻止 Comfy 正常启动的 OpenCV。

o.en:
Another ST workflow, but hopefully not as big as some of the others I've seen. On my 3060, images take 15s to finish, and all 28 takes about 7 minutes. Updates are mostly to fix node problems. If yours works, there's no need to update. Works best on images with black backgrounds.

There are more instructions in the workflow, but the most important thing to remember is to set the batch size to 28 to get all the emotes.

Nodes aligned with NodeAligner:
https://github.com/Tenney95/ComfyUI-NodeAligner

This was made with a version of Comfy with an older version of Python (from 6/27/25). Newer versions have some crap about WAS Suite and whatever OpenCV is that prevents Comfy from launching properly.
